title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Strengthening the Trial Management Work of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Several Opinions on Strengthening the Trial Management of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2011] No. 2

To the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Supreme People's Court's Several Opinions on Strengthening the Trial Management of People's Courts are hereby printed and distributed to you. Please implement them earnestly in light of local conditions.

January 6, 2011

Several Opinions on Strengthening the Trial Management of People's Courts

In order to further strengthen the trial management of people's courts, standardize judicial conduct, improve the quality and efficiency of trial work, and achieve the overall objective of judicial fairness, integrity, and service to the people, in accordance with the Organic Law of the People's Courts, the Judges Law, and other laws, as well as the provisions of relevant judicial interpretations, and in light of the actual trial work of people's courts, the following opinions are put forward:

1. Overview of Trial Management

1. Strengthening trial management is an inevitable requirement for practicing the guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes" and the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," and for implementing the work policy of "strictly governing the courts, establishing credibility, and strengthening courts with science and technology." It is an important measure to promote the three key tasks and achieve the scientific development of people's courts' work in the new era. People's courts at all levels shall, in the spirit of being highly responsible to the Party and the people, to the Constitution and laws, and to the trial cause, strengthen management awareness, increase work efforts, and fully leverage the role of trial management in regulating, guaranteeing, promoting, and serving trials.

2. In carrying out trial management, people's courts shall use methods such as organization, leadership, guidance, evaluation, supervision, and constraint to reasonably arrange trial work, strictly regulate trial processes, scientifically evaluate trial quality and efficiency, effectively integrate judicial resources, and ensure judicial fairness, integrity, and efficiency.

2. Basic Requirements for Trial Management

3. In carrying out trial management, it is necessary to adhere to the law as the basis, strictly determine the responsibilities of trial management in accordance with the provisions of laws and judicial interpretations, and properly handle the relationship between management and trials. While strengthening supervision and constraint on trial activities, it is also necessary to avoid exceeding legal provisions to interfere with trial business departments and judges in handling cases according to law. In carrying out trial management, it is necessary to correctly define the scope of management functions and other functions. Management must be in place but not overstepping. Matters that fall within the responsibility of trial management shall be managed boldly. Matters involving other functional departments in trial management shall be handled by those other functional departments.

4. In carrying out trial management, it is necessary to take the Scientific Outlook on Development as guidance and adhere to overall consideration. It is necessary to adhere to full-staff management. The president, division heads, presiding judges, and judges are all subjects of trial management. Each management subject shall clarify its rights, obligations, and job responsibilities. It is necessary to adhere to full-process management. All trial stages from case filing to case assignment, scheduling, trial, adjudication, and enforcement shall be managed and supervised to ensure that the trial process is rigorous, standardized, open, and transparent, and that the trial results are fair and efficient. It is necessary to adhere to comprehensive management. Management shall strengthen not only the management of trial quality and efficiency but also the management of trial effects, striving to achieve case closure and dispute resolution, and realizing the organic unity of the legal effect and social effect of handling cases.

5. In carrying out trial management, efforts shall be focused on improving the hierarchical management system within people's courts. The Adjudication Committee and the president shall assume the responsibility for macro-management of trial work, accurately assess the operational situation of trial work, summarize trial experience, and promptly identify and address issues arising in trial work. The president, division heads, and presiding judges shall, while supervising and guiding the handling of cases according to law, effectively assume the responsibility of managing judges and cases. They shall implement various systems and work requirements for trial quality management, trial efficiency management, and trial effect management into each link of case adjudication.

6. In carrying out trial management, it is necessary to effectively strengthen the trial-level management of lower-level people's courts and improve the overall effectiveness of trial work in people's courts. Higher-level people's courts shall deeply analyze and study the overall situation of trial work within their jurisdiction, strengthen macro-guidance over lower-level people's courts, and promote the coordinated development of trial work. Through methods such as hearing cases, convening trial business meetings, and discussing typical cases, they shall promptly summarize experience, unify the application of law, unify adjudication standards, and improve the overall level of justice.

7. In carrying out trial management, it is necessary to adhere to the concept of serving trials. It is necessary to respect the laws of trials. The various working mechanisms and management methods of trial management shall fully consider the characteristics of trial work and conform to the actual circumstances of trial work. Service shall be embedded in management. While strengthening supervision and constraint, efforts shall be focused on serving trial work, creating favorable conditions for the lawful and orderly operation of the trial power, and providing necessary guarantees. While regulating judges' judicial conduct through management, judges' rights shall be respected in management, and attention shall be paid to the problems and difficulties encountered by judges in trial work, so as to fully mobilize judges' work enthusiasm and subjective initiative and improve judicial efficiency.

3. Basic Functions of Trial Management

8. Strengthen the construction of trial management systems and fully leverage the functions and advantages of system management. Efforts shall be focused on improving the trial management system, with an emphasis on establishing and improving the system of trial quality management, trial efficiency management, trial process management, and trial performance assessment, so as to achieve the standardization of trial management. Efforts shall be focused on improving the trial quality and efficiency evaluation index system, scientifically and reasonably setting evaluation indicators and their weights, and fully leveraging the role of the evaluation index system in trial quality management, trial efficiency management, and trial effect management, so as to achieve the scientification of trial management.

9. Effectively strengthen trial quality management. It is necessary to establish and improve a long-term mechanism for case quality evaluation that is consistent with the actual circumstances of trial work, improve evaluation standards, and strengthen case quality evaluation. Through case quality evaluation, the overall quality and efficiency of trial work shall be improved. Attention shall be paid to the practical application of case quality evaluation results, achieving the organic unity of evaluating cases and summarizing trial experience, the organic unity of constraint mechanisms and incentive mechanisms, and the organic unity of evaluation results and performance assessment. In light of prominent issues in trial work during a certain period, while carrying out routine case quality evaluations each year, special and focused case quality evaluations shall be strengthened, especially the evaluation of key cases such as litigation-related petition cases and cases of public concern, so as to promote the resolution of social conflicts.

10. Effectively strengthen trial efficiency management. In light of the overall operational situation of trial work, it is necessary to reasonably allocate trial resources, clarify the classification standards for simple cases and difficult complex cases, achieve the separation of complex and simple cases, and improve trial efficiency. It is necessary to improve the dynamic monitoring mechanism for trial time limits, implement prompts and early warnings for trial time limits, standardize the formalities for approving extensions and deductions of trial time limits, and strengthen the management of case trial time limits, so as to promote case closure within the statutory trial time limits. It is necessary to establish and improve the case reminder and supervision system, strengthen the awareness of balanced case closure, and form a dynamic balance mechanism for case receipt and closure that conforms to the laws of trial work, so as to achieve balanced case closure.

11. Effectively strengthen trial process management. Trial process management is the foundation of trial quality management and trial efficiency management. It is necessary to rely on computer information technology to promptly improve the case management information platform. People's courts that do not yet have the conditions shall also make full use of existing equipment and conditions, adapt to local conditions, improve systems, and make trial process management more scientific, standardized, and refined. It is necessary to improve the trial process management system, strengthen procedural monitoring and node management of case adjudication, and achieve management of process nodes such as case filing, case assignment, trial, adjudication, enforcement, and archiving, so that no node is omitted and the entire process is monitored. It is necessary to firmly implement the trial process management system, clarify the monitoring responsibilities for each node, and assign node management to specific departments and personnel, ensuring that case adjudication is conducted according to law, fairly, and efficiently.

12. Effectively strengthen the analysis of trial operation trends and achieve macro-management of trial work. Accurately grasping the overall operational situation of trial work is a prerequisite for people's courts to assess the trial work situation and make scientific decisions. It is necessary to establish and improve the monitoring mechanism for trial operation trends. Through channels such as case quality evaluation, trial process management, and judicial statistics, relevant data and materials shall be widely collected to analyze and assess the operational situation of trial work, promptly identify and resolve issues affecting case quality and efficiency, and ensure the healthy and orderly development of trial work.

13. Effectively strengthen trial performance management and achieve the organic integration of trial management with post goal assessment and team building. Relying on the trial quality and efficiency evaluation index system, a trial performance assessment mechanism that is both consistent with the actual circumstances of trial work and simple and easy to implement shall be established. It is necessary to scientifically set trial performance assessment indicators, guide judges to focus on trial quality and efficiency, focus on clean and civilized justice, focus on the legal effect and social effect of handling cases, and achieve case closure and dispute resolution. Trial performance assessment indicators shall be adjusted in a timely manner according to the actual circumstances of trial work, and dynamic management shall be implemented to ensure the correct guiding role of trial performance management. It is necessary to establish a connection mechanism between trial management and assessment rewards and punishments, and use trial performance assessment results as the main basis for judges' selection for commendation and awards, promotion in rank and position, so as to fully leverage the comprehensive effect of promoting case management through personnel management and combining case management with personnel management.

14. Effectively strengthen the summarization of trial experience and promote the improvement of judicial competence and judicial level. For issues of a universal or overall nature discovered in trial management, higher-level people's courts shall strengthen guidance to lower-level courts, and lower-level courts shall promptly study, summarize, report, and request instructions, so as to resolve problems before they take shape or become serious, ensuring that the trial work of people's courts always proceeds healthily and smoothly. It is necessary to be good at discovering typical cases in trial work, promoting experience, summarizing lessons, and enhancing the guiding and warning role of typical cases.

4. Positioning and Basic Responsibilities of the Trial Management Office

15. In strengthening trial management, it is necessary to fully leverage the coordinating and communicating role of the Trial Management Office so that the trial management work of all departments forms a joint force. Within the overall framework of people's courts' trial management work, the Trial Management Office serves as the staff assistant to the Adjudication Committee and the president, acts as a hub connecting the upper and lower levels and linking all parties, and is a comprehensive trial business department of people's courts specifically dedicated to trial management. All higher and intermediate people's courts, as well as qualified basic-level people's courts, shall establish a Trial Management Office. Basic-level people's courts may also assign the trial supervision division to undertake the functions of trial management. The Trial Management Office of higher-level people's courts shall strengthen guidance over the trial management work of basic-level people's courts.

16. The Trial Management Office mainly undertakes trial management responsibilities such as daily affairs of the Adjudication Committee, trial process management, case quality evaluation, analysis of trial operation trends, and summarization of trial experience. People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the requirements of ensuring trial quality, improving trial efficiency, and achieving good trial effects, scientifically and reasonably integrate the management responsibilities of various departments, and effectively leverage the overall joint force of the Trial Management Office and other functional departments in the trial management work of people's courts.

5. Matters Related to Trial Management

17. Attention shall be paid to the coordination and communication between trial management and the personnel management and administrative management of people's courts, so as to form a pattern of division of labor, cooperation, and mutual support among the three major management areas of trials, personnel, and administration in people's courts. A coordination mechanism between trial management, personnel management, and administrative management shall be established. Specialized trial management institutions shall cultivate awareness of coordination, cooperation, and service, provide objective, scientific, and reasonable bases for the organization and personnel departments in conducting trial performance assessments and human resource allocation, and cooperate with administrative departments in doing a good job of informationalization construction, material resource allocation, and other guarantee work, so as to jointly promote the overall improvement of the management level of people's courts.

18. It is necessary to strengthen the construction of informationalization infrastructure, increase scientific and technological investment, continuously improve hardware facilities, establish and improve the case management information system, gradually establish a trial management network covering the national courts, and form a national court case information database and case information query system. It is necessary to fully leverage the role of information technology in trial management, actively promote the application of information technology in case scheduling, quality evaluation, trial process, file management, performance assessment, judicial statistics, human resource allocation, and other aspects, achieve the informationalization of trial management, and promote the transformation of trial management from extensive management to intensive and refined management. It is necessary to ensure the security of trial information and establish an information security guarantee mechanism by taking measures in terms of personnel, technology, and systems.

19. It is necessary to focus on strengthening the construction of the specialized trial management institution team, and bring personnel with strong political quality, rich trial experience, and certain management ability and organizational coordination ability into the trial management team, so as to improve the overall quality and level of the trial management team. It is necessary to vigorously strengthen the training of the trial management team, further enhance the political awareness, legal awareness, overall situation awareness, and responsibility awareness of trial management personnel, and further improve their management skills and ability to use information technology. When evaluating trial professional titles, promoting them in rank and position, and selecting them for commendation and awards, personnel engaged in specialized trial management shall be treated equally with those in trial business departments.

20. The summarization of trial management work experience shall be effectively strengthened. It is necessary to vigorously strengthen investigation and research to provide a theoretical and practical basis for further innovation and development of trial management. It is necessary to use various forms and carriers to summarize and exchange trial management work experience, study and discuss theoretical and practical issues, and continuously promote the innovation and development of trial management. In light of new situations, new tasks, and new circumstances, and on the basis of fully absorbing and drawing on existing trial management achievements, it is necessary to boldly try and innovate, actively explore new mechanisms and new methods that are both consistent with the actual needs of trials and can operate efficiently, and comprehensively improve the level of trial management.
